sentences.text: Task 1. Charlie and Fatima are meeting to finalize the details for a tour.
Listen to their conversation and complete the information in the spaces below.
The first one has been provided as an example.
You now have 30 seconds to study the task.
At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers.
Morning Fatima. Oh hi.
How are the preparations going for that cultural tour to Henry’s Umbrella Store?
Yeah, OK. So, do you think we can start the tours in December?
Oh yeah, definitely.
Definitely. December weather’s perfect for old town tours like this one.
Yeah, so how often do we want to run these tours then?
I reckon we can have them every Saturday.
OK. And each Saturday, we can have two time slots, One at 9am and one at 4: 30pm.
Perfect. Nine o clock for the early birds and half past four for everybody else.
OK, and let’s make sure we get the address right on the webpage this time not like the other one.
Yeah, OK. The store’s at 16 Prince Edward West Road.
Right, let me We make a quick note of that.
16 Prince Edward West Road.
And how can they get there from the MTR station?
Well, there’s a car park near the MTR station.
So, it’s the same route if they’re walking from the MTR or if they’re coming from the car park.
From the MTR station Exit E, they walk past Bison Boy School before making a right turn.
I’m trying to remember the area.
Don’t they have to walk past Rare Bird Garden and Bright Flower Market before making the right?
That'll take them further away from the store.
They need to take the first right and the the store’s just across from Rich Avenue Building.
It’s hard to miss.
OK, and what kind of activities will the tour include?
Hmm, well, to start the tour, the store owner will give a talk.
But only listening to him talk might be a bit boring.
Is there going to be anything else?
Oh, of course, there is.
They will join a handmade umbrella workshop.
I bet most people have never tried that.
Hand made umbrella workshop?
Wow! And what we’re going to do is, you know, to get young people interested, we're going to have an Instagram photo session at the end of the tour.
That’s a great idea.
Good, an Instagram photo session will definitely attract a lot of people.
Do you think we need to provide free bottled water for the participants?
Mmm, I’m not sure.
Bottled water creates a lot of plastic waste.
I’ve talked with the store owner.
he says he will be providing participants with traditional Chinese tea that his family used to have.
That will be perfect.
I always have English Breakfast tea at home in winter.
I think we should avoid printing leaflets they just get thrown away.
Yeah. Everyone seems to be using QR codes with tours these days instead of leaflets.
But I don’t think that matches the style of the umbrella repair store.
No, you're right.
So maybe we can give participants a souvenir.
Well, the store owner has actually offered to give participants umbrellas with the store all logo as a souvenir.
OK, good. So, have you thought about how we should promote the tour before December?
Hmmm, yes. I was thinking we can promote it on social media.
I mean, it’s the most popular way of promoting events nowadays.
It’s definitely popular.
What else can we use?
Oh, actually we'll be using posters as well.
Really? Any particular reason why you want to use posters?
I mean it’s a lot of work.
because we want to promote the tour in schools.
OK. That’s a good idea.
We could maybe get a bit of interest going in young people and teaches if we promote the tour in schools.
Let’s hope so.
